description: Turn Exclusive Playback on or off (dashboard: Security > Anti-Download > "Reprodução Exclusiva", Beta). When ON, the on-demand videos of the account are served only to the Panda Player: the Panda Player embedded by iframe keeps working on any site allowed by domain protection (members areas that use the embed included), while custom players, scrapers or extensions that open the HLS (m3u8) link directly get a decoy video. It deters casual capture; it is not DRM. Covers on-demand videos, Libras and the main audio; does not cover live streams, dubbed audio tracks, subtitles or downloads (they keep working). Requires the Simple Anti-Download to be ON (checked before changing; turn it on with panda_action_set_anti_download); turning Simple Anti-Download off turns Exclusive Playback off too. Turning on is only for plans that include Simple Anti-Download (Gold/Enterprise and others; Silver/Bronze need the "Anti-Download Simples" add-on, contracted in the dashboard; not available on Clipador/Clipper and VSL Only plans).

enabled.description: true = only the Panda Player plays the videos; false = stop
